prerequisites: Command of English at least at B1 level.

learning_outcomes.text: The student has the capability of working with specialist vocabulary.
The student has acquired skills necessary for understanding the main ideas of complex texts on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in their field of specialisation.
The student has the ability to interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity.
The student has the ability to present various topics, describe facts and explain procedures with an emphasis on technology-specific functions.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, U1 – vocabulary: physics and scientific discoveries; past tenses, present perfect, and questions revision
U1 – explaining the function of a device, past participle clauses
U2 – product specifications, passive forms revision, expressing functions or purpose
U2 – participating in a meeting or discussion, revision – Review Unit
U3 – vocabulary: automotive engineering; the continuous aspect, linking devices
U3 – note-taking during a lecture, linkers of contrast
U4 – vocabulary: networks and maintenance; phrasal verbs, using active or passive verb forms
U4 – the outline of a presentation, describing stages of development, revision – Review Unit
U5 – vocabulary: steelmaking; describing a process, purpose clauses
U5 – describing a process: aluminium smelting, revision

assessment_methods.method: Active participation in class and fulfilment of optional assignments

assessment_rules: To fulfil credit requirements, students must earn a minimum of 24 marks in total from active participation and the credit test. Students can earn 4 marks for active participation and 40 marks for the credit test. If the minimum is not achieved, a resit of the test is possible once in the exam period. Active participation, including attendance (allowed to miss two seminars), is a credit requirement.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
